prompt: We are building a healthcare API that accepts FHIR Patient and Observation resources. Plan validation and REST endpoint behavior before implementation.
Our startup has its first SOC 2 audit in three months. Plan how to track control owners, evidence, and readiness gaps.
We have monthly revenue by region in a pandas dataframe. Plan a clear Python chart showing trends without misleading the reader.
We need to edit an existing Word .docx contract, preserve its formatting, and add a table of revised delivery dates. Plan the document workflow.
Our budget.xlsx workbook has broken formulas and inconsistent number formats. Plan how to repair and validate it while preserving working formulas.
Requests traverse three microservices but our logs cannot explain latency. Plan OpenTelemetry spans, metrics, and exporter setup to correlate the calls.
We need speaker-labelled transcripts from recorded customer interviews using Deepgram. Plan the transcription integration and output handling.
Our GitHub repository needs a workflow to lint and test pull requests and publish only after a tagged release. Plan a safe GitHub Actions setup.
We are moving a product catalogue with variants and frequently updated inventory to MongoDB. Plan which fields to embed versus reference and how to index queries.
A Python batch job now takes forty minutes and consumes too much RAM. Plan evidence-based profiling and optimization without changing its results.
